A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Semantic Generative Tuning and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Corresponding material can be matched throughout; the additional v2 page belongs to the references.

before.justification: v1 reports original BAGEL and OmniGen2 experiments, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, attention analyses and additional quantitative results in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 2–3, appendix Tables 6–7 and 9, and the mechanistic analyses.

M1.justification: The segmentation-based generative proxy, model components, objectives and inference procedures remain unchanged. The revised overview illustration does not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same COCO proxy tasks, SAM segmentation data, LLaVA-OneVision instruction data and evaluation benchmarks, including appendix coverage. Figure 1 changes illustrative imagery without adding an evaluated scenario.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Table 2 and the corresponding ablation experiments are unchanged. Newly cited works do not appear as additional evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Figure 6 changes its stated SFT:Seg training ratio from 2:1 to 1:2. This corrects the reported setting to match Section 4.3, which already specified 1:2 in v1; unchanged curves provide no evidence of rerunning the experiment. Other settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The proxy-task comparisons, mixed-task ablation, data-mixture and scaling studies, feature visualizations and attention analyses are retained. The Figure 6 caption correction adds no new analysis or plotted evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same twelve-seed averaging statements for generation evaluations, including Table 3 and appendix Table 7. No repeated-run information or uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and experimental qualitative examples remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendix. For example, Table 3 retains BAGEL SFT+SGT scores of 79.23 on CV-Bench and 80.95 on GenEval; Figure 6 retains the same curves.

T1.justification: The task formulation in Equation 1, generative-tuning objective and appendix mathematical procedures are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, propositions or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: hierarchical proxy-task investigation, segmentation-based SGT, improved multimodal performance and feature/attention explanations. Novelty and applicability claims are not substantively revised.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning semantic alignment, perception versus reasoning, and attention allocation remain unchanged. Section 5 and the appendix retain the same limitations concerning knowledge-intensive tasks and complex instruction following; edits to the limitations paragraph are grammatical.

D1.justification: The Figure 6 correction revises the documented training mixture from SFT:Seg 2:1 to 1:2, removing inconsistent reproducibility information. Appendix preprocessing, optimizer settings, training budgets, inference details and the project-page link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Six works are newly cited in the introduction and Section 2.2: From Instruction to Event, Video2BEV, SelM, SpatialViz-Bench, Mono2Stereo and DME. These expand citation support without substantially rewriting the discussion or changing the paper's positioning.

P1.justification: Limited copyediting corrects 'systematically evaluation' to 'systematic evaluation', 'UMMS' to 'UMMs', and 'as show' to 'as shown'. A duplicate MetaQueries reference is consolidated. Section organization and the overall narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 replaces the original portrait examples with Mona Lisa imagery and adjusts styling while preserving its three-panel explanation. Figure 6's caption is corrected. Bibliographic page back-references are removed and the references reflow; other figures and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 6's SFT:Seg ratio resolves a contradiction with Section 4.3 and clarifies the documented training comparison. Small language corrections and duplicate-reference cleanup also improve accuracy. These are limited gains because the method, empirical evidence and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
